title: RHCSA log
headline: Studying for the RHCSA (EX200)
summary: RHCSA practice log: weekly writeups and a bash script per chapter
intro: I landed on the RHCSA as a solid goal for my Linux development: it's clear-cut, practical and pretty comprehensive for a first cert. I'd already worked through a good chunk of Sander van Vugt's RHCSA prep book, but quickly found that understanding something is a long way from doing it from memory with just a man page at your disposal. Hence this log (badum-ts), where I periodically keep track of how things are progressing. I've thrown away what I did so far and started anew, with an emphasis on repetition: I only move on to the next chapter once I've hammered out a script or two quite a few times with no mistakes. I invite you to take a gander!
passed_label: Passed in a timed mock exam
label: EX200 · RHEL 10
